reason: The submitted CIF is valid and symmetry-expands in F-43m (No. 216) to a 16-atom conventional cell, Yb4Al4Ga4Ir4 (primitive YbAlGaIr), with a = 6.3586 angstrom, full occupancies, and the stated Yb-4a/Ir-4b/Al-4c/Ga-4d ordering. All 11 calculated reflections through 90 degrees are observed and indexed, including the weak 311, 331, and 511/333 ordering-sensitive lines; there are no important unexplained reflections. The instantiated-CIF intensity comparison gives an integrated-area residual of about 3.8%, and an independent whole-profile audit gives 4.57% versus a 4.22% independent-intensity profile bound, whereas the two other crystallographically distinct four-sublattice ordering classes give approximately 49-51%. Pair swaps within the surviving class primitive-standardize to the same structure, and disorder lowers the odd-reflection intensities and worsens the fit. Periodic shells have no overlaps (shortest contacts 2.753 angstrom), full coordination shells are chemically plausible for an intermetallic, and no stoichiometric or occupancy defect remains. Another attempt is therefore unlikely to add a materially different viable candidate.
